role: Senior Staff Engineer, Business Intelligence and Looker AI
responsibilities: Provide technical and strategic guidance to a team of skilled engineers, encouraging innovation and ensuring successful project delivery in the areas of Semantic Modeling, AI, Business Intelligence.

Establish and maintain strong connections with the partner leadership team, serving as the primary contact for team deliverables. Partner closely with stakeholders to align priorities, gather requirements, and meet business objectives.
Uphold Google's standards by focusing on reliability, security, and operational efficiency within large-scale distributed systems.
Mentor and grow team members and foster a culture of empowerment.
